# Third-party notices for retained portable inputs

These notices apply only to the exact artifacts listed in
`portable-unicode-inputs-v1.json`. Aleph's repository license does not replace
the licenses below.

## Unicode Character Database 15.1 data

`NormalizationTest.txt`, `CaseFolding.txt`, and `PropList.txt` are Unicode, Inc.
data files obtained from the official Unicode 15.1 UCD distribution. They are
retained under the Unicode License v3 (`Unicode-3.0`). The exact license bytes
acquired with this lock are in `unicode/UNICODE-LICENSE-v3.txt`; the manifest
records their source URL, size, and SHA-256 digest.

## unicodedata2 15.1.0 wheels

The retained CPython 3.11 and 3.12 manylinux x86-64 wheels are the official
`unicodedata2` 15.1.0 PyPI release artifacts. Their package metadata declares
Apache License 2.0 (`Apache-2.0`). The exact license bytes embedded identically
at `unicodedata2-15.1.0.dist-info/LICENSE` in both wheels are retained in
`unicodedata2/Apache-2.0.txt`; the manifest records the source artifact, member
path, size, and SHA-256 digest.
